## 2. Proposed Canonical Schema Set

Layout under `public/data/entities/` and `public/data/combat/`. All JSON Schema draft 2020-12, stored in `public/schemas/v1/`. IDs are global and unique across all entity files.

```
public/data/entities/heroes.json       # playable + variant appearances (classDefault)
public/data/entities/npcs.json         # story/recruit NPCs (playable:false)
public/data/entities/companions.json   # CLASS_PETS + COMPANIONS_ACT1 + HIREABLES_ACT1
public/data/entities/enemies.json      # ALL non-boss combat enemies (every id that appears in any encounter)
public/data/entities/bosses.json       # all bosses incl. hidden bosses
public/data/combat/encounters.json     # compositions — reference entity ids only
public/data/combat/drop-tables.json    # BOSS_LOOT_TABLES + BOSS_TAP_DROPS
public/data/combat/boss-phases.json    # BOSS_PHASES + BOSS_DEATH_DIALOG
```

### entity-base schema (shared `$defs`, `public/schemas/v1/entity.json`)
```json
{
  "$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id":"https://emberveil/schemas/v1/entity.json",
  "$defs":{
    "statusEffect":{"type":"object","required":["type","chance"],
      "properties":{"type":{"type":"string"},"chance":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},
        "duration":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},"power":{"type":"number"}},"additionalProperties":false},
    "range":{"type":"array","prefixItems":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"number"}],"minItems":2,"maxItems":2},
    "combatant":{
      "type":"object",
      "required":["id","name","hp","dmg","armor","hit","dodge","xpValue"],
      "properties":{
        "id":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$"},
        "name":{"type":"string"},
        "act":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":6},
        "hp":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},
        "maxHp":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},
        "dmg":{"$ref":"#/$defs/range"},
        "armor":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},
        "hit":{"type":"integer"},"dodge":{"type":"integer"},
        "xpValue":{"type":"integer","minimum":0},
        "magicResist":{"type":"integer","default":0},
        "gold":{"$ref":"#/$defs/range"},
        "loot":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},
        "spellList":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},
        "spellChance":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},
        "statusOnHit":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/$defs/statusEffect"},
                                {"type":"array","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/statusEffect"}}]},
        "blockChance":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1},
        "stealableBuffs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},
        "isBoss":{"type":"boolean","default":false},
        "sprite":{"type":"string"}
      },
      "additionalProperties":false
    }
  }
}
```
Rule: `maxHp` defaults to `hp` if absent (loader normalizes). Every existing inline field maps 1:1.

### enemies.json / bosses.json

{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
 "type":"object","required":["version","entities"],

     "uniqueItems":true}}}

Bosses identical but `isBoss` must be `true`.

### heroes.json / npcs.json (`appearance.json` superset — keep existing fields)

### encounters.json — references only, no inline stats
```json
{"type":"object","required":["version","encounters"],

      "name":{"type":"string"},

## 4. Migration Sequence (each step shippable + testable, staging-first)

**Phase 0 (parallelizable, no behavior change):**
1. Author JSON schemas in `public/schemas/v1/` (entity, encounters, drop-tables, boss-phases). *(agent A)*
2. Write a one-shot **extraction script** that imports the live JS (`mapData.js` etc.) and serializes the *currently-running* values to the new JSON files — guarantees byte-for-byte behavioral parity, including all 3 conflicting `void_wraith` variants (these become distinct ids `void_wraith`, `void_wraith_tide` etc., or per-encounter `overrides`). *(agent B, depends on schemas)*
3. Build a **parity diff script** (see §5). *(agent C, parallel)*

**Phase 1 — enemies/encounters (sequential, the dangerous core):**
4. Add `src/game/dataLoader.js`; have `mapData.js` populate ENEMIES/ENCOUNTERS/HIDDEN_BOSS from JSON at boot. Ship behind a flag; run full sim/balance/regression — must be identical. **SAVE-COMPAT CHECKPOINT (see §6).**
5. Delete inline enemy literals from `mapData.js` once parity is green.

**Phase 2 — bosses/loot/phases/companions/appearances (parallelizable after Phase 1):**
6. drop-tables.json + bossLoot.js refactor *(agent D)*
7. boss-phases.json + bossPhases/bossDeathDialog *(agent E)*
8. companions.json + companions.js/TownScreen *(agent F)*
9. heroes/npcs.json + appearances.js *(agent G)* — depends on nothing in Phase 1.

**Phase 3 — kill the scrapers (sequential, after Phase 2):**
10. Rewrite `emit-game-data.cjs` to pass-through; rewrite `build-appearances-manifest.cjs` to glob-only.
11. Repoint `enemy-catalog.html` + all catalog pages to canonical JSON. Remove inlined snapshot.

**Phase 4:** delete dead code paths, update `package.json` prebuild.

Parallelizable: Phase 0 (all), Phase 2 (D/E/F/G independent). Strictly sequential: 4→5, 10→11, and Phase 1 before Phase 3.

## 5. Test / Verification Plan
- **Parity diff script** (`scripts/verify-canonical-parity.mjs`): import legacy JS (git-stashed copy or pre-migration tag) and the new loader; for every encounter key, expand to flat enemy list and deep-equal each enemy object field-by-field. Fail on any diff. This is the gate for steps 4 &amp; 5.
- **Game-vs-images.html diff**: script enumerating every entity id referenced by any encounter/boss/hidden-boss, assert each has an `appearances-manifest.json` entry with ≥1 sprite; assert no manifest entity is absent from canonical JSON. This directly proves the giant_spider class of bug is closed.
- `npm test` (vitest: `balance.test.js`, `simulator.test.js`, `damage_pipeline*`, `stats_persistence`) must pass unchanged.
- `node scripts/save-load-test.mjs` against `/home/radgh/claude/assets/references/emberveil/saves` — zero load errors, all required fields present.
- `node scripts/check-regression.mjs` + balance snapshot within `regression-thresholds.json` (combat numbers must not move; behavioral parity is the bar).
- Staging deploy + `smoke-test-deployed.sh`.

## 6. Risks + Single Most Dangerous Step + Rollback

**Save-compat intersection (precise):** `GameState.toSaveData()` (`gameState.js:487`) serializes the whole `_state` blob. **Combat/encounter/enemy objects are NOT persisted** — no `combatState`/`encounter` keys exist; combat is transient and rebuilt from ENCOUNTERS on each fight. The save schema intersection is limited to: (a) **party/companion members** embed `class`, `appearance`, `templateId`, `attrs`, `level` (NOT enemy stats); (b) post-run `history.finalParty` (`gameState.js:134`). Therefore enemy/encounter stat migration is **save-safe** as long as: every entity **id referenced by saved party members** (companion `templateId`, hero `appearance`) still resolves in `companions.json`/`heroes.json`/`npcs.json`. Companion/appearance migration (steps 8–9) is where save-compat can break — a renamed/dropped id orphans a saved companion's sprite/stats. Mitigation: ids are preserved verbatim from the extraction script (step 2); add an id-presence assertion to `save-load-test.mjs` covering all ids found in the reference saves.

**Most dangerous step: Step 4** (loader takes over ENEMIES/ENCOUNTERS for live combat). It touches every fight, the simulator, and balance baselines simultaneously; a single mistransformed `{...ENEMIES.x,count}` → `{ref,count,overrides}` silently changes combat math (the conflicting `void_wraith`/`dragon_whelp` variants are the trap — collapsing them to one stat block would alter Act 4/6 difficulty). Rollback: feature flag in `dataLoader.js` (`USE_CANONICAL_DATA`); if parity/regression fails on staging, flip flag to fall back to the still-present JS literals (don't delete literals until step 5 is green on staging). Git tag `pre-canonical-migration` before Phase 1 for hard revert.

---

## Executive Summary (~250 words)

The game derives entity/combat data from four independent, drifting paths: live JS literals (`ENEMIES`/`ENEMIES_ACT4-6`/`ENCOUNTERS`/`HIDDEN_BOSS_ENCOUNTERS` in `mapData.js`, `APPEARANCES`, `CLASS_PETS`, `BOSS_LOOT_TABLES`); a regex scraper (`emit-game-data.cjs:220`) that structurally cannot see inline encounter enemies; the manifest builder downstream of it; and a build-frozen snapshot inlined in `enemy-catalog.html`. Confirmed drift: `giant_spider` exists only inline (the reported bug), and `void_wraith`/`dragon_whelp` carry three conflicting stat sets under one id.

**Chosen file split:** `public/data/entities/{heroes,npcs,companions,enemies,bosses}.json` + `public/data/combat/{encounters,drop-tables,boss-phases}.json`. Encounters reference entity ids with `count`/`overrides`; drop tables reference item ids; schemas in `public/schemas/v1/`.

**Sequence:** (0) author schemas, extract live JS values to JSON for byte-parity, build a parity-diff gate — parallelizable; (1) add `dataLoader.js`, populate `mapData.js` from JSON behind a flag, verify parity, then delete literals — sequential; (2) migrate bosses/loot/phases/companions/appearances — four parallel agents; (3) gut `emit-game-data.cjs` to pass-through and repoint catalog pages — sequential after 2; (4) cleanup.

**Save-compat danger:** combat is never persisted, so enemy migration is save-safe; the only intersection is saved party/companion `templateId`/`appearance` ids — Phase 2 steps 8–9 must preserve ids verbatim or saved companions orphan. Most dangerous step is Step 4 (live combat takeover); mitigated by a `USE_CANONICAL_DATA` flag and keeping JS literals until staging parity is green.

**Parallelizes:** all of Phase 0; Phase 2 agents D/E/F/G. **Sequential:** Phase 1 (4→5) before Phase 3 (10→11).

### 3. Exact resolution semantics `verify-canonical-parity.mjs` implements for `{ref,count,overrides}`
This is the contract the extraction agent and future `dataLoader.js` must match:

```
base     = enemies.json.entities[ref]  ??  bosses.json.entities[ref]   // enemies dict first, bosses fallback
merged   = { ...base, ...(overrides || {}) }                            // top-level key REPLACE (mirrors JS spread; arrays/objects swapped wholesale, not deep-merged element-wise)
resolved = { ...merged, count }                                         // count is a property carried ON the group object
```

`resolved` is then deep-equaled, field-by-field, against the **legacy live `encounter.enemies[i]` group object** (the already-materialized `{ ...ENEMIES.x, count }` literal from `src/maps/mapData.js`, imported as a pure-Node ESM module — it imports cleanly). Comparison is at the **group level, not exploded by `count`**: `count` is compared as a field because the simulator/CombatScreen explode it into N instances identically downstream regardless of source, so NG+/act scaling never enters the parity check. LEGACY = `{...ENCOUNTERS, ...HIDDEN_BOSS_ENCOUNTERS}` unified by key; encounter-level `name`/`introText` are also compared. Encounter-key set membership is checked both ways. Summary on success: `PARITY OK: N encounters, M enemy instances, 0 diffs`.

**Validated end-to-end against synthetic fixtures derived from live mapData.js:**
- Faithful resolution → `PARITY OK: 49 encounters, 178 enemy instances, 0 diffs`, exit 0.

### 1. The 39 diffs grouped by class

**Single class — `extra key in canon` (39 diffs across 20 inline encounter groups):**

Every diff was the same shape:

legacy: &lt;undefined&gt;   canon: [&lt;loot array&gt; | &lt;statusOnHit array&gt;]   why: extra key in canon
```

The 20 affected inline groups: `dragon_patrol/{dragon_whelp,dragon_cultist}`, `wyrm_citadel/{wyrm_warrior,dragon_whelp}`, `frost_wyrm_pack/{frost_wyrm,wyrm_warrior}`, `storm_dragon_nest/{storm_dragon,dragon_cultist}`, `dragon_elite/{wyrm_warrior,frost_wyrm,storm_dragon}`, `ancient_dragon_fight/{ancient_dragon,dragon_whelp}`, `dragon_king_fight/{dragon_king,ancient_dragon,wyrm_warrior}`, `big_dragon_skyfall/{dragon_whelp,wyrm_warrior,dragon_cultist}`, `big_void_tide/void_wraith`. 19 groups missing both `loot`+`statusOnHit` (38 diffs) + `big_void_tide/void_wraith` missing only `statusOnHit` (1 diff) = 39.

## M519 Story Mode QA — Final Report

**Date:** 2026-05-21
**Tests:** 761 Vitest unit + 28 Playwright E2E (3 baseline + 25 new)
**Build:** Clean (0 errors, 200 pre-existing lint warnings)
**Release:** game13_releases/dist/ at milestone 519

| Step | Scope | Result |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | New-game flow: StoryNewGameScreen loads | PASS |
| 2 | Continue button text: "Continue to Character Creation" | PASS |

---

### Bugs fixed

**BUG-1 — BLOCKER — `recentHistory` type conflict**

`StoryMapScreen._resolveNodeTravel()` and `_refreshPressureChip()` both called `.push()` / `.slice()` on `gs.story.recentHistory` as if it were a flat array. The storyLedger defines it as an object `{ nodeTypes:[], biomes:[], ... }`. This threw a JS page error that prevented StoryMapScreen from rendering after cinematic skip.

Fixed in `src/ui/screens/StoryMapScreen.js` — push to `.nodeTypes[]`, read `.nodeTypes` in slice path with legacy array fallback.

**BUG-2 — HIGH — Fog-of-war tabs all unlocked on fresh map**

`_isRegionReachable()` tested `visibilityCache !== 'hidden'`. The BFS from trailhead marks every node visible through open edges, so all 5 tabs unlocked immediately.

Fixed: region `i &gt; 0` now requires at least one node in region `i` or region `i-1` with state `visited` or `cleared`.

**MEDIUM-1 — Portrait images not displayed in carousel (now fixed)**

`StoryNewGameScreen.js` was not rendering the `&lt;img&gt;` tag for portraits. Added `&lt;img class="sng-card-portrait"&gt;` to the card template and added CSS (80x106px, `object-fit: cover`, `border-radius: 4px`) to the STYLES constant.

---

- `/home/radgh/claude/game13/src/ui/screens/StoryMapScreen.js` — BUG-1 and BUG-2 fixes
